# Original interesting-sound entry

Original executable SHA256:
`0040e2c0683b4d73a5fb976e400d5087dca680df2b195c9e27f8edbda2d4974a`.
No original asset or executable is included.

Both startup FPU controls, `0xe3f` and `0x23f`, execute identical **5,511
contexts including eight raw faults**. All **555 instruction bytes** execute:
root `5466F0`295, actual subclass predicate `534020`14, actual called recent
sound `545DA0`179 and actual RNG `415FA0`67. No instruction or arithmetic
is substituted. Only tile `411160`, path `50B810`, trace `535250` and Push
`50A260` are declared world services. This does not certify their transitive
terrain behavior. Frame/FPS observations are passive original loads.

The original caches its entry MUD before marker/age admission. Tile and path
receive the actual cached MUD coordinate pointer; trace copies coordinates
after path. A successful trace calls actual `545DA0`, reloading the object's
current MUD, marker and clocks. Failed trace pushes59/56/70/69/7; coordinate
arguments are loaded after the corresponding Push. Every admitted nonfaulting
outer entry clears its cached marker and succeeds, even if the child rejected
changed state. Inputs cover all Push masks, repeated independent/embedded
records, real RNG seeds0/1/4094/4095, age/FPS DWORD wrap, subclass/class bits,
raw coordinates and callback mutations of pointers, positions and clocks.

Inputs, producer, results and C/Go consumers are frozen before engine edits.
Gzip SHA256:
`7dc57fa677f9de65736d89bf2f13dd26b11cc86b051e3650e77a18208065199e`.
Decoded SHA256:
`b8cda36a229995b93f0c44f8d8c381226eeb7b30a2942b6bf87b4a0a0d82b01a`.
Original heap writes, code/RNG-table bytes, nonvolatile registers, stack,
FPU control/TOP and canaries are independently checked. Native comparisons
exercise the public C entry and direct Go raw entry with whole C-owned native
records, padding/neighbors, pointer projections, high argument-word sentinels,
real production prand, ordered services and raw fault prefixes.

The unchanged actual public C entry SIGSEGVs after above4GiB C/Go layout and
full initial-record controls pass (`41344960077`, source `b749043`). The exact
binary, raw output and API-digest-verified complete archive are retained.
Private generators, both original outputs and all seals/proofs remain under
`ROOT/monster-interesting-sound-native-entry-port`.

The earlier variadic-hook comparison harness is retained verbatim in a test
file; production now supplies real services to the raw core. Existing harness
assertions are unchanged and receive no new production-equivalence credit.
Separate composition tests use real clocks/RNG/Push/empty native wall tracing
with declared tile/path services. This reference does not prove all terrain,
campaign, speaker-output, networking or overall porting completion.
